_comment: Named test user profiles for multi-scenario parameterization. Select a profile at runtime with --user-profile <name>. Credentials with null values must be injected via environment variables (never commit real credentials here).

default._description: Standard Health100 QA user — loaded automatically when no --user-profile is given. Credentials come from credentials.qa.js / environment.

aetna-member._description: Health100 user with active Aetna benefits plan — use for Benefits/Dashboard, Benefits/Claims, Benefits/IDCard flows.

caremark-user._description: Health100 user with Caremark pharmacy access — use for Benefits/CaremarkUser and InNetworkPharmacy flows.

no-benefits._description: Health100 user with no active benefits plan — use for Benefits/Consent and error-state flows.

smart-scheduler._description: Health100 user eligible for Smart Scheduler — use for Smart_Sch flows.

cvs-qa._description: CVS Health app QA user — use with cvshealth suite flows.
